annotations.title: CSV missing-value report: blank and sentinel counts per column

description: Count how much is missing in each column of a CSV, separating truly blank cells from sentinel values such as NA, null, none, '-', and reporting present counts. Choose this before analysis to see how complete each column is, with blank cells and sentinel values such as NA, null, none and '-' counted separately. Do not choose this when you need values imputed or a custom sentinel recognised; only the built-in sentinel list is used. Example requests: Which columns of this CSV have the most missing values? | How many missing, NA and blank cells are in this CSV? | Report completeness per column before I analyse this file.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: CSV missing-value report: blank and sentinel counts per column

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_csv_missing_value_report

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.
